card.text: The first exoplanet photographed by JWST: a young giant of about seven Jupiter masses.

sources.label: Carter et al. 2023
sources.quote: representing the first images of an exoplanet to be obtained by JWST

introduction.text: HIP 65426 b is a young giant planet about 90 au from its star. JWST imaged it from 2 to 16 microns, and VLTI/GRAVITY has tracked its orbit since 2021.

sources.label: Blunt et al. 2023
sources.quote: at a projected separation of 92 au from its primary

sources.label: Carter et al. 2023
sources.quote: the first ever direct detection of an exoplanet beyond 5

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
